title: lomatium serpentinum
intro: Lomatium serpentinum, commonly known as Sulfur Flower, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of western North America. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium serpentinum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoferulic acid, coumarins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
